up: CREATE FUNCTION feed_peek(target integer, max_messages integer, max_bytes integer) RETURNS TABLE (lsn pg_lsn, data bytea) LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $fn$ DECLARE item record; emitted integer := 0; total bigint := 0; BEGIN IF target < 1 OR target > 10000 OR max_messages < 4 OR max_messages > 10000 OR max_bytes < 1024 OR max_bytes > 1048576 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FEED_BATCH_BOUNDS'; END IF; FOR item IN SELECT * FROM pg_logical_slot_peek_binary_changes(current_setting('nightscout.feed_slot'), NULL, target, 'proto_version', '1', 'publication_names', current_setting('nightscout.feed_publication')) LOOP emitted := emitted + 1; total := total + octet_length(item.data); IF emitted > max_messages OR total > max_bytes THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FEED_BATCH_BOUNDS'; END IF; lsn := item.lsn; data := item.data; RETURN NEXT; END LOOP; END $fn$
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION feed_peek(integer, integer, integer) FROM PUBLIC

CREATE FUNCTION feed_advance(upto pg_lsn) RETURNS pg_lsn LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $fn$ DECLARE result pg_lsn; BEGIN SELECT end_lsn INTO result FROM pg_replication_slot_advance(current_setting('nightscout.feed_slot'), upto); RETURN result; END $fn$
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION feed_advance(pg_lsn) FROM PUBLIC
